GameConditionDef.label: Extreme blizzard
GameConditionDef.letterText:
An extreme snowstorm began to ravage this area.

I don't know why, but this blizzard is particularly unsettling.
The impenetrable snow clouds isolate this place from the outside world, and everything that happens here in the short term will not be known to the outside world.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: This extreme blizzard is gradually subsiding. Although the snow clouds have not completely dissipated, sunlight has already emerged from the gaps in the layers, as if eager to paint the ending for the blizzard.
